page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 256.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and external services. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

The hardware profile emphasizes compute density over memory capacity, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring high parallel processing power without massive memory footprints. The lack of hyperthreading ensures dedicated execution resources per vCPU, though the absence of local storage represents a tradeoff that requires architectural planning for disk-intensive tasks.

The ecs.c7.32xlarge is designed for compute-heavy workloads. Suitable applications include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, video encoding, and large-scale web serving or application servers that do not require local disk storage or high memory-to-CPU ratios.
